product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an agentic mobile observability platform for mobile engineering teams that detects, prioritizes, and helps resolve app performance issues across iOS and Android.

pricing_page.notes: Luciq has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The company announcement names these as apps powered by its platform.

employee_band.notes: The company listing gives the 201–500 range; YC separately lists a team size of 250.

hq_location.notes: The company DPA identifies San Francisco as its principal place of business.

founded_year.notes: Luciq first-party materials give 2013; some third-party sources list 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering blog includes technical posts on legacy-code architecture and iOS CI infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Luciq provides a public documentation site with product guides and feature documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (OpenAI, LLC); the specific model is not identified.
model_provider.notes: Luciq lists OpenAI, LLC as a subprocessor for AI-powered product features.

compliance_certs.notes: The FAQ states SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certified, and GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies the $46 million Series B announced May 17, 2022 as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is from May 2022, outside the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The November 4, 2026 changelog announces Relevant Moments and Multi-Session Summary for Session Replay.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kenny Johnston, formerly Luciq’s Chief Product and Technology Officer, joined Azul as CPO in August 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies Hubspot for marketing automation and Salesforce.com for customer relationship management.
